name: Broken Arrow Wilderness
note: Private campground in oak woods outside Fullerton, a summer base for tubing and stock-tank floats: 49 RV sites in tree clearings, water/electric $30 (30-amp) or $40 (50-amp) and full hookups $35-45 a night; primitive tent sites, monthly sites. Lively on summer weekends. Online booking (Campspot). RV Life 4.5*/$$. --Claude
